Corollary
[Quadratic lower evolution bound for $Z$ in dimension three] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0320 ↗ thm:chow-ii-minimizing-harnack-two-tensor-evolution ↗ rem:chow-ii-three-dimensional-k-term-lower-bound 1. ch15:15.31\group Minimizing Harnack Tensor

In dimension three, as long as $Z\ge 0$, \[ (\nabla _t-\Delta )Z_{ab}\ge 2(\Ric ^{-1})^{cd}Z_{ac}Z_{bd} +\sum _{N,M}L_a^{NM}L_b^{NM}-\frac2tZ_{ab}. \]
Proof

\sketch Substitute the lower bound of Remark 5 into Theorem 5.

□
